# WeRead2Notion AI

> 将微信读书的书架、划线、想法和阅读统计同步到 Notion 的开源工具。

- [日本語ガイド](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hodgekou/weread2notion-AI/main/docs/guide.ja.md)
- [技术参考](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hodgekou/weread2notion-AI/main/docs/TECHNICAL.md) — 模板、CLI、环境变量与开发。
- [v1.0.0 发布说明](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hodgekou/weread2notion-AI/main/docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v1.0.0.md)
